question: In September 2022, who among the following was honoured with the Dadasaheb Phalke Award for the year 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Asha Parekh__**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Dada Saheb Phalke Award for the year 2020 was awarded to actress Asha Parekh.
 
• Asha Parekh was awarded the Padma Shri in 1992.
 
• She also served as the head of the Central Board for Film Certification from 1998-2001.
 
• The 68th National Film Awards will be held on 30 September 2022 and will be presided over by President Droupadi Murmu.
 
• Asha Parekh is a renowned Hindi film actress, director, and producer and an accomplished Indian classical dancer.

 
• Starting her career as a child actor she made her debut as lead heroine in 'Dil Deke Dekho'.
 
• She has acted in over 95 movies including celebrated films like Kati Patang, Teesri Manzil, Love in Tokyo, Aya Saawan Jhoom Ke, Aan Milo Sajna, Mera Gaon Mera Desh. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Dadasaheb Phalke Award is India's highest award in the field of cinema.
 
• It is presented annually at the National Film Awards ceremony by the Directorate of Film Festivals, an organisation set up by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.
 
• It was established in 1969.
